page_title: PAR 1-0 SAS | Parma v Sassuolo 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A player from Sassuolo commits a rough challenge. Niccolo Turrini blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+4' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+3' Alessandro Circati (Parma) makes a strong challenge and Niccolo Turrini blows for a foul.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Alessandro Cardinali (Parma) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
88' The ball spins up and hits the hand of M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
85' The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
83' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Gioele Zacchi (Sassuolo) replaces Stefano Turati.
83' Substitution. Luca Lipani makes his way off the pitch and Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) comes on as his replacement.
82' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
80' 1 - 0 Goal! Pontus Almqvist produces a brilliant lofted pass and Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
78' The game is interrupted now, Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' The opposition can't get near Pontus Almqvist (Parma), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
76' Substitution. Emanuele Valeri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Franco Carboni (Parma).
74' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar.
72' Here is a change. Sascha Britschgi is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
72' Substitution. Mandela Keita will be replaced by Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
71' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
70' It's a throw-in for Sassuolo.
69' The Parma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' The linesman raises his flag. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is adjudged offside.
66' Substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) has come on for Armand Lauriente.
65' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Ismael Kone and he is replaced by Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo).
62' Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.

62' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Stefano Turati sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) for Lautaro Valenti.
61' Parma are awarded a free kick.
61' Niccolo Turrini blows his whistle after Pedro Felipe (Sassuolo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sassuolo.
55' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jay Idzes departs the field of play to be replaced by Pedro Felipe (Sassuolo).
53' That was close. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
52' Niccolo Turrini interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
51' The ball is cleared after Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
47' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) a chance inside the box, but his efforts zips just over the bar.
46' Alessandro Cardinali (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daniel Mikolajewski.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
45' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
43' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Niccolo Turrini blows his whistle for a foul.

40' Mandela Keita (Parma) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Stefano Turati showed his agility and saved this one.
37' Christian Ordonez (Parma) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
36' One of the Sassuolo players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
34' Tommaso Macchioni (Sassuolo) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
33' Sassuolo are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
30' Today's referee Niccolo Turrini rightly decides to book Lautaro Valenti (Parma) for his harsh tackle.
29' Parma are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' A spell of possession for Sassuolo in an attempt to control the game.
22' Parma earn a free kick.
21' Tommaso Macchioni (Sassuolo) has received a yellow card for his foul.
20' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the left post.
18' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Niccolo Turrini didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
18' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
15' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
14' Neat passing move from Parma in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
9' A rebound spins to Daniel Mikolajewski (Parma) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just over the bar.
7' Niccolo Turrini shows the yellow card to Sascha Britschgi (Parma) for a heavy challenge.
6' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
6' One of the Sassuolo players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
4' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
3' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
1' A crossfield pass from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Niccolo Turrini was nominated as the referee for this game.
